title: Computer Music Book in Max MSP
description: Dodge and Jerse's book serves as a good reference for learning DSP. This is to walk through some of their examples with Max.

title: Electrosmith Daisy Seed to make Custom Synth Modules
description: A kickstarter project that started in 2020 is now the hottest board for DSP projects. Perfect for sound installations and making custom eurorack synth modules. This blog post documents the Max/MSP gen~ patch development for a DIY synth workshop hosted by CCAM (Center for Concrete and Abstract Machines).

title: Recreating the EMU Modular System in VCV Rack using Max MSP RNBO
description: The E-mu Modular System was built in 1974 by E-mu Systems.

title: Workflow for this Blog
description: I detail the features of this blog, the intentions, and the code that makes it work.

title: CD40106 Oscillators and Using an Oscilloscope
description: The CD40106 IC has 6 Schmitt-Trigger Inverters that can be used to make 6 simple pulse oscillators. I use this simple circuit to explore how an oscillation is made and how to use an oscilloscope to see what is happening.

title: Controlling a KUKA Robot with Python and RoboDK
description: The RoboDK API has a reference for python scripting. This is a documentation of a simple project to learn the movement of the robot.

title: Traversing Max Graphs to Make Dynamic Patches
description: The Max js object allows scripting within a patcher. With it, you can create, delete, and modify objects for a range of creative possibilities.

title: Experiments with the Game Boy Camera
description: Released in 1998, the Game Boy Camera shot a 128x112 pixel grayscale picture with only 4 colors. Being more than 20 years old, these limitations have interested hobbyists to hack it and get the most out of the hardware.

title: Linking Old and New Analog Video Synthesis
description: An investigation of analog video synthesis through two pioneering synthesizers, the Paik/Abe Synthesizer (1960s) and the Sandin Image Processor (1970s), comparing them to newer digital video synthesizers like Lumen, VSynth for Max/MSP and Hydra.
